item.text: The defect is confirmed in `src/paginate.js`: `Array.prototype.slice` uses an exclusive end index, but the code subtracts one, so every nonempty page returns one item too few. The repository is clean; I’ll leave the unrelated fixture files untouched and capture the failing baseline before editing.
